name: cuda_toolkit
role: THE CUDA toolkit every FSLA workspace compiles with and reads tools from: NVIDIA's redistributable components at the manifest below, by its digest, unpacked into one folder, so every box has the same nvcc and ptxas without installing CUDA (fsla-devtools' environment extension, its `cuda_toolkit` tag). Not put on PATH: torch takes its toolkit from the nvcc on PATH without following links.
